snippet.title: Soulframe - Official Wolf Teaser Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Here's a look at the Wolf Teaser Trailer for Soulframe, an upcoming free-to-play action fantasy RPG developed by Digital Extremes. Players will become acquainted with the deep connection between a mysterious warrior and her wolf. SoulFrame is coming soon to PC (Steam), with the Preludes Early Access for PC available now.
